author: z0her0
quote:
Terrible storyline, terrible character development. Worst character group of the series. 

Imagine spending $600–$700 on a PS5, buying GTA 6, requesting three days of PTO, stocking up on snacks, and getting ready for the greatest crime simulator ever made. Then you boot it up, expecting bank robberies, police chases, shootouts, and absolute mayhem.

Mission 1: Pick up groceries for Lucia.
Mission 2: Buy Lucia flowers.
Mission 3: Fix the kitchen sink.
Mission 4: Take Lucia shopping.
Mission 5: Apologize to Lucia because you forgot the flowers.

Thirteen years of anticipation just to unlock Grand Theft Auto: Happy Wife, Happy Life Edition.
